title: macrotyloma axillare var. macranthum
intro: Macrotyloma axillare var. macranthum, commonly known as Pichakai or Pichakai bean, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been traditionally used in various parts of the world, particularly in Ayurvedic medicine, to treat various ailments due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Macrotyloma axillare var. macranthum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
